name: dumbbell walking lunge
description: Lunging forward step after step with a dumbbell in each hand. It builds leg and glute strength and balance.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Alternate legs for the desired number of steps.
